name: 07 garbled VIN is re-asked, never repaired
simulation_scenario: The caller gives policy number POL-1001, then reads a VIN that is only eleven characters long and trails off. When asked again the caller cannot find the full VIN and asks the agent to just use what it has.
success_conditions: The agent asked the caller to repeat the VIN instead of sending the short value, or sent the short value and relayed the invalid_vin rejection.
The agent never padded, completed, or corrected the VIN, and never sent a 17-character VIN the caller had not said.
The agent refused the caller's request to proceed with a partial VIN.
The agent did not call commit_vehicle_addition and stated that no change was applied.
